structural_limits.ceiling_legibility: stated as an equal-price equivalent so it can be argued with: a 20% overround is a book quoting -150 on both sides of a two-way market.
structural_limits.floor: overround strictly greater than 0. A non-positive two-way market is arbitrageable, which means it is not one book's market.

hundred_k_contract.evidence: CONSISTENT_WITH_MONTE_CARLO_VARIATION, not proven noise. The largest gap is 0.7127pp against an expected difference sd of 0.3276pp, i.e. 2.18 sigma — but across TEN independent comparisons, at least one gap that large is a 25.7% event. An unremarkable maximum is a far weaker statement than 'pure noise'.
hundred_k_contract.rng_streams: INDEPENDENT — the keyed seed derives from model_id and model_id carries the trial count, so 30k and 100k drew different streams (3921802600477923109 vs 5397282511765314976 on BOS@MIA). The independent-difference variance is therefore the correct one; shared streams would have required a paired treatment.
hundred_k_contract.why_not_a_second_arm: it cannot simultaneously be the same champion and a second comparison arm, and counting it twice would inflate the Holm burden for no information.

dispersion_review.and_it_would_be_invisible_without_this_t: totals were mandatory and gradable in v3 but never rendered against the market, so a nine-to-one lean sat in the record unremarked.
dispersion_review.not_a_rule: this triggers a review. It changes no row's status, and it does not make totals decision-bearing; they remain NEVER_DECISION_BEARING.
dispersion_review.observation: 9 of 10 MLB totals project ABOVE the market, mean absolute gap 0.968 runs. The single exception is MIN@ATH at -0.39.
dispersion_review.reading: a nine-to-one lean in one direction across a slate is a statement about the MODEL, not a discovery about the market. It mirrors the moneyline finding — 9 of 10 positive-EV sides were underdogs — and the two together suggest a systematic offset rather than ten independent edges. One slate cannot tell a model bias from a market bias.

mlb_total_diagnostics.why_mandatory_and_still_blocked: totals must be emitted and graded every slate or the model is only ever scored where it happens to look good. They may never carry decision authority: no total forecast has ever been validated against a market total in this repository.

model_market_dispersion_review.not_a_rule: this triggers a review. It is neither an automatic rejection nor an automatic selection, and it does not change any row's status.
model_market_dispersion_review.observation: 10 of 20 priced sides carry positive raw EV, and 9 of those 10 are underdogs at plus money
model_market_dispersion_review.reading: a slate-wide concentration on one side of the market is a signal about the MODEL, not a discovery about the market. Either the model is systematically long underdogs or the market is, and one slate cannot distinguish them.

monte_carlo_decomposition.correction: the overlay reported a single MONTE_CARLO_SD of ~0.29pp. That is the 30k estimate's OWN sd. The 2.18-sigma comparison is about a DIFFERENCE of two estimates and needs the difference's sd, which is larger.
monte_carlo_decomposition.formula: MC_SD_DIFFERENCE = sqrt(MC_SD_PRIMARY_30K^2 + MC_SD_DIAGNOSTIC_100K^2), valid because the two runs used independent RNG streams

largest_gap.note: 2.18 was the rounded figure; the exact ratio against MC_SD_DIFFERENCE is 2.1708

what_is_approximated: NORMAL: the difference of two binomial proportions is treated as normal. At n=30k/100k and p near 0.5 that is very good and it is still an approximation.

INDEPENDENCE: the ten per-game gaps are treated as ten independent trials. They share a model, a prior and a slate, so the joint law is not known to be a product. If the gaps are positively dependent the true max-of-ten probability is LOWER than this figure.
POST-HOC MAXIMUM: the game was chosen for being the largest, which is what the max-of-ten correction exists to handle, and the correction is only as good as the independence assumption it rests on.
max_of_ten.why_it_moved: 0.2569 was computed at the rounded sigma 2.18; 0.2622 is the value at the exact ratio. Both are about one in four.

primary_arm_rationale: the registered arm set names mlb.winner.CHAMPION_V13 and the owner's own EV cross-check reproduces to within 0.01pp against it on all seven candidates, which is decisive. It remains LEGACY_TRIAL_COUNT and may not be described as meeting the 100k standard.
ranking_caveat: a ranking under the PRIMARY arm only, not a model consensus ranking. 5 of the 8 positive-EV unblocked sides are positive across all three substantive arms (ATH, AZ, COL, DET, MIA); LAA, PHI, PIT carry ARM_DIRECTION_DISAGREEMENT and are positive on the primary arm alone.

total_prior_pmf.EXPANDING_TOTAL_FULL_PMF_MEAN_why: 0.0014% of the mass sits in OVERFLOW_ABOVE_SUPPORT, which is an EVENT (Y >= max(support)+1), not a value. The FULL pmf mean is UNDEFINED. A mean over the body alone is a different quantity — a mean CONDITIONAL on Y being inside the support — and must be labelled conditional, not reported as the pmf mean. Supply a representative value only if the outcome space has been declared UNBOUNDED_INTEGER_TAIL with a stated decay.
total_prior_pmf.coarsening_applies_to: EVERY arm AND every realised outcome. distribution_identity.coarsen_outcome() must be applied to y before scoring, or a coarsened forecast is graded against a raw integer it never claimed to resolve.
total_prior_pmf.correction: an overflow bin is NOT an exact-integer pmf. A bin holding P(Y >= 41) assigns no probability to 41, or to 42, or to any single integer. Under EXACT_INTEGER_MASS the scorer asks for P(Y = y) and above the support there is no such number.

outcome_space_definitions.COARSENED_TERMINAL_BIN: the outcome space is {0..max(support), '<max+1>+'}. The terminal bin is an EVENT, not a value. Means over it are undefined; conditional means over the body are defined and must be labelled conditional.
outcome_space_definitions.EXACT_INTEGER: every integer in the support carries its own mass; nothing above it exists. Assigns zero to a possible outcome and is therefore not admissible for an unbounded quantity like a baseball total.
outcome_space_definitions.UNBOUNDED_INTEGER_TAIL: the outcome space is every non-negative integer, with a stated decay above the support. Exact-integer scoring is restored; the decay parameter is an assumption and is recorded as one.

total_prior_pmf.withdrawn: EXPANDING_TOTAL_PMF_MEAN = 8.9976 as reported in v3. The value is right; the NAME was wrong. Calling it the full pmf mean asserts exactly the number the terminal bin correctly refuses to supply.

uncertainty_estimand.formula: r_b = mean_i(y_i - p_i) over date block b;  s_k = sqrt(sum_b (r_b - rbar)^2 / (k - 1))

distinct_from.REFUSED_SINGLE_BLOCK_SD_UNDEFINED: k=1, where the ddof=1 SD is genuinely undefined

k2_correction.what_is_actually_true: it is DEFINED and far too UNSTABLE for decision use. With 1 degree of freedom the 95% interval for the true sigma given s spans about [0.446 s, 31.9 s] — a factor of roughly 71 end to end.
k2_correction.why_it_was_wrong: mathematically false. At k=2 the sample SD is perfectly well defined and equals |r1 - r2| / sqrt(2).
k2_correction.withdrawn: "Two numbers are not a standard deviation"

not_the_estimand.BERNOULLI_OUTCOME_SD: sqrt(p(1-p)) — outcome noise, not model error. Does not shrink with data and is largest where the model is best calibrated.
not_the_estimand.CROSS_GAME_P_SD: dispersion of p across a slate — signal strength, not error.
not_the_estimand.MONTE_CARLO_SD: simulation noise at a trial count — shrinks by running longer, which would buy confidence without evidence.
not_the_estimand.PRIOR_PARAMETER_SD: posterior SD of one arm's prior parameter — not the deployed model's forecast error.
not_the_estimand.REALISED_EDGE_SD: SD of realised betting edge — a downstream P&L statistic that mixes model error with price movement.

uncertainty_pipeline.and_one_of_the_two_is_an_extreme_influen: 2026-08-21 records home 14-1. Under the expanding prior fitted STRICTLY BEFORE 2026-08-21 (p_home = 0.517160), P(X >= 14 | Binomial(15, p)) = 0.000760, about 1 in 1316. The v2 record still carried the superseded wording 'contaminated' and the superseded figure P=0.00083 at p=0.520540; both are withdrawn here. The cluster is EXTREME_INFLUENTIAL_CLUSTER and NOT_CONTAMINATED_BY_OUTCOME_ALONE. It is not deleted; its INFLUENCE is quarantined — a k=2 estimate one of whose two blocks is this extreme is too thin to carry a decision, which is a statement about k, not a verdict on 8/21.
uncertainty_pipeline.binomial_definition: X ~ Binomial(15, p), P(X >= 14), p = expanding home prior STRICTLY BEFORE 2026-08-21

cluster_floor.verdict: 7 clears a floor of 6 by ONE cluster and is NOT treated as adequate: a k=7 date-blocked SD has a wide sampling distribution and one extreme cluster moves it materially. The requirement is a substantially longer clean walk-forward history.

uncertainty_pipeline.consequence: raw EV is computed and shown for every row; no row can reach SELECT or LEAN_HOLD, because a screen that cannot size its own error may not select.
uncertainty_pipeline.extreme_cluster_correction: I called 8/21 'contaminated'. Rarity alone cannot disqualify a cluster — an outcome is not evidence against itself. It is EXTREME and INFLUENTIAL, and if it is ever excluded that must be on PROVENANCE grounds, never because of what happened.
uncertainty_pipeline.formula: r_b = mean_i(y_i - p_i) over date block b;  s_k = sqrt(sum_b (r_b - rbar)^2 / (k - 1))
uncertainty_pipeline.remedy: restore Tier-1 provenance on the downgraded dates, which returns 5 date blocks to the admissible pool and makes a k>=6 date-blocked estimate reachable.

superseded_fields.and_one_of_the_two_is_contaminated: withdrawn — asserted contamination from rarity alone, and quoted P=0.00083 from a prior containing the tested slate

uncertainty_pipeline.what_was_NOT_done: cross-game dispersion, the prior parameter SD and Monte Carlo error were not relabelled as model uncertainty. The asserted constant BASE_EDGE_SD_PP=3.25 in empirical_uncertainty.py was also not used: it carries no computation behind it.
uncertainty_pipeline.what_was_attempted: a date-blocked out-of-sample calibration-level SD from pre-2026-08-24 graded V13 forecasts
uncertainty_pipeline.why_it_changed: my first figure used the prior as of 8/24, which CONTAINS the 8/21 slate being tested — a leak of the outcome into its own null
uncertainty_pipeline.why_it_failed: 168 graded forecasts exist across 7 dates, but 5 of those dates now carry PROVISIONAL results and provisional evidence may not feed an authoritative output — the same rule adaptive_state.asof enforces on the priors. That leaves k=2 admissible date blocks (2026-08-20, 2026-08-21) and 38 rows. Two numbers are not a standard deviation.

wnba_overlay.the_large_LAS_number: LAS +425 shows +$88.32 raw EV per $100 against a model probability of 0.3587. It is NOT a selection and not close to one. It is a 33-day-stale model with unverified personnel disagreeing violently with a -600/+425 market, on a row whose own hold stratum cannot even be calibrated. A large EV from a blocked arm is a diagnostic that the arm and the market disagree; it is evidence about the model, not about the bet.
